 'cos*x':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])+p[5]*x,
 'cos*xv':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])+p[5]*x*v,
 'cosx*v':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])*x+p[5]*v,
 'cosx*v2':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])*v+p[5]*x,
 'cosxv':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])*x*v,
 'cosv2':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])*v**2,
 'cosx2':lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.sqrt(v))+p[2]*np.cos(p[3]*t+p[4])*x**2,
}
for k,f in models.items():
    best=None
